part: Rear shock tower of the speedrun chassis, new design for the speedrun upper bulkhead
coordinate_system: Plane of the plate: x across the car (x = 0 centre line, as the bulkheads), y height above the parting face of the bulkheads, z = 0 back face (contact face on the shock tower wall of the upper bulkhead), z = thickness front face (damper side). In the coordinates of the bulkheads: x = x, y = tower_face_y - z, z = axis_z + y.
shared_parameters: cad/bulkhead/bulkhead_upper_parameters.json: mounting holes (tower_hole_x, tower_hole_h_lower, tower_hole_h_upper), contact face (tower_face_y), block in front of the wall (gear_block_h), root radius of the wall (wall_root_r). cad/bulkhead/bulkhead_lower_parameters.json: half width of the bulkheads (body_half_width), parting face (axis_z).
design: Flat plate in the style of the front shock tower: straight top edge over the width of the bulkhead, rising straight edges to round ends around the body post mounts, straight edges down to round lobes around the camber link holes, straight bottom edge above the block in front of the wall. The damper holes lie inside the wings. The damper and body post holes are in the stock positions. The camber link holes are moved outward as on the front tower, so that the rod ends have space beside the wall of the speedrun upper bulkhead. Edges: chamfer 0.5 on both faces; on the back face, the chamfer increases to the relief of the root radius along the bottom edge; holes with chamfers of 0.3.

source_codes.user: Measurement or information from the owner of the car
source_codes.photo: Estimate from photos of the car
source_codes.design: Design choice of the model, free

thickness.note: Carbon plate, 3 mm (owner), as the stock rear shock tower. The upper bulkhead is designed for it: screws M3x8 through the tower, 5 mm thread engagement in the wall.

hole_d.note: Through holes M3 (mounting screws M3x8, damper ball studs, camber link ball studs, screw of the body post mount).

hole_chamfer.note: Chamfer of the hole edges on both faces (no sharp edges).

stock_hole_d.note: Assumed diameter of the holes of the stock rear shock tower. The measurements of the owner refer to the edges of these holes (top of the lower mounting hole, outer end of the upper mounting hole).

camber_dx.note: Stock rear shock tower: centre of the hole of the wheel mount (camber link) 8.5 mm outward from the top of the lower mounting hole.

camber_dy.note: Stock rear shock tower: centre of the hole of the wheel mount 5 mm below the top of the lower mounting hole.

damper_dx.note: Stock rear shock tower: centre of the damper hole 25 mm outward from the outer end of the upper mounting hole.

damper_dy.note: Stock rear shock tower: centre of the damper hole 2 mm above the upper mounting hole (corrected by the owner, before: 2 mm below).

body_post_dx.note: Stock rear shock tower: the bottom of the body post bore lies 40.5 mm outward from the outer end of the upper mounting hole, at the height of the centre of the upper mounting hole.

body_post_d.note: Diameter of the body post bore.

body_post_gap.note: Distance from the top of the body post bore to the bottom of the bore of the body post screw.

body_post_screw_d.note: Diameter of the bore of the body post screw above the body post bore.

body_post_end_r.note: Radius of the round ends around the two body post bores (edge 1.9 mm around the 5.2 mm bore).

rod_end_clearance_r.note: Radius around the axis of the camber link ball stud that is kept free behind the tower for the rod end (estimate, as the front tower; to be measured).

rod_end_depth.note: Length of the zone kept free for the rod end behind the back face of the tower (estimate).

lobe_r.note: Outer radius of the lobes around the camber link holes (edge 1.9 mm around the hole).

top_margin.note: Material above the upper mounting holes: the straight top edge over the width of the bulkhead lies 1.9 mm above their edges.

top_corner_r.note: Radius of the corners between the straight top edge and the rising edges (as the corner radius of the bulkheads).

bottom_gap.note: Gap between the bottom edge of the tower and the block in front of the wall (17.8 mm above the parting face).

side_gap.note: Gap between the tower and the side faces of the bulkhead where the tower reaches below the block.

inside_r.note: Radius of the inside corners at the bottom edge (end mill 2 mm).

edge_chamfer.note: Chamfer of the outline edges on both faces, as the edge chamfers of the bulkheads.

root_clearance.note: Relief on the back face along the bottom edge: chamfer at 45 degrees with the legs root radius of the wall + 0.25, as the front tower.
